title: The Rapture is Coming - Are You Ready?
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he explores the truth about the Rapture of the Church, a doctrine that will change everything you thought you knew about Jesus' return. Discover the Bible's promise of a glorious and imminent event that will sweep believers off the earth and into the presence of their beloved Savior. Get ready to be encouraged and empowered by Pastor Chris's passionate and biblically-grounded teaching on this crucial topic.
